title: Rotation-Based Subspace Tracking for Robust Kernel PCA on Streaming Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.15488v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning models process large amounts of data, and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a widely used technique to reduce the dimensionality of the data and extract useful features. In practice, datasets often change over time (data drift) and/or arrive one sample at a time (streaming data), making it infeasible to process the entire dataset at once in batch mode. Real-world data also often contains nonlinear patterns, which traditional PCA cannot extract. Kernel PCA addresses this by implicitly mapping samples into a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS). Raw data also often contains outliers, which can have an outsized effect on the estimated subspace unless the algorithm is made robust. translated_title: 基于旋转的子空间追踪方法：面向流式数据的鲁棒核主成分分析
translated_abstract: 机器学习模型需要处理大量数据，主成分分析（PCA）是一种广泛使用的技术，用于降低数据维度并提取有用特征。在实际应用中，数据集通常会随时间变化（数据漂移）和/或一次只到达一个样本（流式数据），这使得无法以批处理模式一次性处理整个数据集。现实世界的数据通常还包含非线性模式，而传统PCA无法提取这些模式。核PCA通过将样本隐式映射到再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）来解决这一问题。原始数据通常还包含离群值，除非算法具备鲁棒性，否则这些离群值可能对估计的子空间产生过大的影响。然而，现有的在线鲁棒核PCA算法被设计为收敛到一个假定为固定的子空间，一旦完成初始对齐，基于梯度下降的更新在追踪后续变化时就会失去有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于旋转的子空间追踪方法，使鲁棒核主成分分析能够在数据漂移和流式数据场景下持续有效地追踪子空间变化，克服了现有基于梯度下降的算法在完成初始对齐后无法追踪后续变化的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a rotation-based subspace tracking method that enables robust kernel PCA to continuously track subspace changes under data drift and streaming settings, overcoming the limitation of existing gradient-descent-based algorithms that lose tracking effectiveness after initial alignment.
